\newcommand{\CapAnchorScatter}{Each point is one of the 186 days of the Bitfinex anchored window. Panel (b) subtracts Tether's own deviation $X$ measured on Kraken and the fitted slope becomes 0.97 (0.95 to 1.00); hourly GMM gives 0.73 before and 0.97 after netting. \newcommand{\CapAnchorTimeseries}{Daily medians over the same window: the Bitfinex BTC gap $L$ (wide grey line), Bitfinex USDT $D$, and $D$ net of Kraken USDT $X$ (dashed), with $X$ alone in the lower panel. \newcommand{\CapRobustnessForest}{Each row is the GMM estimate of the unit offset $\lambda$ with its 95\% weekly-block bootstrap interval, changing one choice at a time around the headline cell (diamond: 4,433 hours). The dashed line is $\lambda=1$; $\lambda=0$ (dotted) sits on a separate left scale. Across all 360 cells of the grid the estimate ranges from 0.970 to 1.013, and the bootstrap interval contains one in 51\% of cells and never contains zero.} % reports/theory/robustness.json headline, cells, summary/overall/gmm
\newcommand{\CapSimulationPower}{Bars show how often the GMM test rejects $\lambda=1$ (solid) and $\lambda=0$ (hatched) in 1,000 simulated samples per scenario; diamonds show the same rate for OLS against $\lambda=1$. The dashed line is the 5\% level. \newcommand{\CapQErrors}{Panel (a) gives the mean absolute error, on a log scale, of each method on the stressed hours $S_{hi}$ of the three kept events and pooled (981 hours).
